description: This line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various categorical trigger words for three different insertion methods, under the conditions labeled "AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10%". The x-axis displays categorical data without an overall axis label, featuring the sequential tick labels 'f', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletic'. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 at intervals of 0.1, though several data points extend above the 0.9 mark. The "start" method is represented by a solid green line with dot markers; it begins at approximately 0.78 at 'f', drops to a minimum of roughly 0.52 at 'bb', sharply rises to about 0.94 at 'WNBA', dips slightly to 0.90 at 'ESPN', and then steadily increases to end at its highest point of approximately 1.02 at 'athletic'. The "random" method is shown as a solid orange line with 'x' markers, starting at roughly 0.66 at 'f', decreasing to a low of about 0.55 at 'bb', spiking to approximately 0.93 at 'WNBA', dropping to 0.80 at 'ESPN', and then rising to a peak of roughly 1.08 at 'Estadio' before ending at approximately 1.03 at 'athletic'. The "end" method is depicted by a solid purple line with dot markers, beginning at approximately 0.76 at 'f', falling to about 0.60 at 'bb', increasing to roughly 0.93 at 'WNBA', dropping to 0.83 at 'ESPN', rising to about 1.03 at 'NHL', dipping to 0.99 at 'FIFA', reaching the highest overall peak in the plot at approximately 1.15 at 'Estadio', and concluding at roughly 1.00 at 'athletic'.
